title: また同じ歌
subject: an old wife on Amami teasing her husband for playing the same sanshin song every evening for forty years
caption: Amami island shima-uta folk with a light modern frame. An Amami sanshin tuned high and played with a thin bamboo pick, picking a bright repeating melody with small slides, a chijin hand drum giving sparse accents, hand claps from the backing singers in the chorus, a soft brushed drum kit and a low ambient pad entering only in the second half. Intimate and roomy like a porch at night, sanshin and voice forward, everything else low and far back. Female lead voice, high, with long drawn-out vowels and sudden flips into falsetto in the Amami guin style, answered by an older male voice in call-and-response. 84 BPM, A minor pentatonic. Teasing tenderness after forty years. No Okinawan Ryukyu-scale melody, no eisa taiko, no Okinawan pop band arrangement, no enka vibrato or orchestra, no autotune, no electric guitar, no four-on-the-floor.
lyrics:
[Intro - short free-time sanshin]

[Verse 1 - female]
晩ごはん片付けて 縁側に出ると
あんたは もう 三線 抱えてる
四十年 毎晩 同じ一曲
蚊取り線香と 同じくらい 決まってる

[Pre-Chorus - female]
たまには 違うの 弾いたらって
言うと 黙って 糸を締め直す

[Chorus - female]
また 同じ歌 また 同じ歌
あんたが 十九の 夏に
うちの垣根の外で 弾いた歌
[Chorus - male answer]
同じでいい 同じでいい

[Verse 2 - female]
初めて聴いたのは 夜の九時ごろ
下手くそで 三回 間違えて
父ちゃんが 石を投げに 出ていった
あんたは逃げて 次の晩も来た

[Chorus - female]
また 同じ歌 また 同じ歌
今でも ちょっと 下手くそで
続きは 私が 歌ってやる
[Chorus - male answer]
同じでいい 同じでいい

[Outro - sanshin and claps, fading]
もう一回 弾きな
蚊が来る前に
